rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something positioned underneath or below something else.

example.english: I found a book underneath the table.
example.traditional: 我喺張枱下面搵到本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 haa6 min6 wan2 dou2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when stressing the position directly under an object, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: The cat hid underneath the bed.
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 nik1 zo2 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dai2 haa6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that something is underneath or below A.

example.english: I found a shoe underneath the table.
example.jyutping: hai2 zoeng1 toi2 haa6 min6 wan2 dou2 zek3 haai4

rows.note: Use this for something worn underneath another item of clothing.

example.english: I usually wear a vest underneath my shirt.
example.traditional: 我通常喺恤衫入面着件背心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hai2 seot1 saam1 jap6 min6 zoek3 gin6 bui3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the underside or lower face of an object.

example.english: I found chewing gum stuck underneath the tabletop, on its underside.
example.traditional: 我搵到啲香口膠黐喺枱面底面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 dou2 di1 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1 ci1 hai2 toi2 min6 dai2 min6
